new_roles.title: Director of Operational Excellence and Implementation (REMOTE)
new_roles.description:
**Job Summary:** 
 
The **Director of Operational Excellence and Implementation** provides strategic leadership and execution support for priority operational initiatives in partnership with the Chief Operating Officer and Operations leaders. This role translates organizational priorities into actionable implementation plans, leads assigned cross-functional initiatives, improves operational processes, and drives sustainable improvements in how work is performed.

The Director leads efforts to move initiatives from strategy through execution by developing implementation plans, establishing timelines and accountability, coordinating cross-functional activities, identifying risks and barriers, measuring progress, and providing clear visibility to leadership. The role also partners with teams to evaluate and redesign processes, strengthen procedures and documentation, improve cross-training and operational continuity, and identify opportunities to enhance efficiency through technology, automation, and self-service.

This role requires demonstrated experience leading operational improvement initiatives, managing complex projects, influencing across teams, and successfully implementing change. Success in this role requires strong strategic thinking, project execution, problem-solving, communication, and relationship-building skills, along with the ability to drive accountability and deliver measurable results.

This role follows a hybrid work arrangement, with the majority of time worked remotely and periodic in-office requirements in our downtown Chicago office.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Implementation and Project Coordination** **(40%)**

* **Develop and maintain implementation plans, timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and action items for priority Operations initiatives.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coordinate activities across teams and follow up on commitments, deliverables, and outstanding actions.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Track project progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and issues requiring leadership attention.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Prepare concise status updates and other progress reporting for the COO and appropriate leaders.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Lead assigned cross-functional Operations initiatives from planning through implementation, working with department leaders to establish accountability, resolve barriers, and deliver agreed upon outcomes.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Facilitate working sessions to clarify responsibilities, resolve implementation issues, and move work from discussion to action.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Partner with Operations leaders to advance agreed priorities, clarify responsibilities, and strengthen accountability while maintaining departmental ownership of ongoing operations.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Process Improvement (30%)**

* **Review and document selected operational processes and workflows.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Work with staff to identify unnecessary steps, manual work, duplication, unclear handoffs, and other opportunities for improvement.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Develop practical recommendations to simplify workflows, improve consistency, and strengthen operational effectiveness.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Lead assigned process improvement initiatives in partnership with department leaders, including implementation and evaluation of results.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help develop and maintain standard operating procedures and other operational documentation.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthen cross-training and backup coverage for critical processes.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identify appropriate opportunities to improve workflows through technology, automation, and self-service.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Operational Change and Coordination (20%)**

* **Lead or coordinate implementation of assigned process, technology, and organizational changes within Operations, in partnership with the responsible department leaders.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coordinate operational activities associated with selected technology implementations and other modernization initiatives.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help ensure changes are supported by appropriate documentation, communications, training, and follow-up.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Bring together the appropriate staff and leaders when work crosses departmental boundaries.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help clarify responsibilities and handoffs when ownership is unclear.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identify implementation barriers and work with the appropriate leaders to resolve or escalate them.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Monitor recently implemented changes and help address issues affecting adoption or effectiveness.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Measurement and Reporting (10%)**

* **Establish practical measures for selected initiatives and operational improvements.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Develop baseline information when needed to evaluate the impact of a change.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Monitor whether implemented changes are achieving expected results.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Use available operational data and staff or candidate feedback to identify areas requiring additional attention.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Provide the COO with clear visibility into progress, risks, workload, and outstanding decisions.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Initial Focus Areas:**

*(Initial assignments are expected to include)*

* **Supporting implementation of priority Operations initiatives within DANB’s strategic roadmap.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Establishing a consistent approach for planning, tracking, and reporting major Operations projects.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Supporting process improvement in selected candidate-facing areas, including Document Review, Client Services, and Certification Operations.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identifying opportunities to reduce manual work and improve workflows through process redesign and technology.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthening procedures, documentation, cross-training, and backup coverage.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Supporting implementation of approved changes to Operations roles, responsibilities, and processes.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Skills and Attributes:**

* **Strong organizational and project implementation skills with consistent attention to follow-through.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Ability to organize complex work into clear plans, responsibilities, timelines, and next steps.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.**
 --------------------------------------------------------
* **Effective facilitator who can help teams move from discussion to decisions and action.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong written and verbal communication skills.**
 ---------------------------------------------------
* **Collaborative and skilled at building productive relationships across teams and functions.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Able to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and recognize when issues require escalation.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Demonstrated ability to influence leaders and teams, establish accountability, and drive initiatives to completion without direct supervisory authority.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Practical approach to process improvement that avoids unnecessary complexity or bureaucracy.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Comfortable learning new systems, technologies, and operational processes.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Education & Qualifications:**

* **Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience required.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Minimum 8 years of progressively responsible experience in operations, project implementation, process improvement, or business operations, including demonstrated responsibility for leading complex, cross-functional initiatives required.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Demonstrated success leading initiatives from planning through implementation, including delivering measurable operational improvements.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience reviewing and improving business processes and workflows.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience supporting technology-enabled operational change preferred.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience in certification, credentialing, assessment, associations, nonprofits, healthcare, or another regulated environment is preferred.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Physical Demands:**

Required to sit for extended periods of time; may need to walk or stand in the course of work as well as light (20-30 lbs.) to medium (30-40 lbs.) levels of lifting of supplies and/or equipment.

**Work Environment:**

Work performed in an office environment, either onsite or offsite; periodic travel to be expected (<10%)

new_roles.title: Executive Director, Research Administration Transformation & Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
Discover Your Career at Emory University: Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community. Description:

The Executive Director for Research Administration Transformation & Operational Excellence provides executive strategic and operational leadership for the Office of Research Administration's (ORA) enterprise-wide transformation portfolio.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Leads an enterprise-wide transformation portfolio spanning research administration functions across schools, units, and Emory Healthcare, requiring university-wide change leadership and executive influence.
* Partners with Artificial Intelligence & Digital Strategy (AI & DS) to implement a broad portfolio that includes enterprise technology implementation (including the Insight grants management system), organizational redesign, shared services transformation, operational performance improvement, artificial intelligence and emerging technology strategy, and research administration training and professional development.
* Directs implementation, ongoing maintenance, and optimization of enterprise systems and tools, including Insight and LegalSifter, and ensures that technology investments support the future-state operating model.
* Co-leads implementation and ongoing review of future-state operating model, including organizational design, workflow refinement, shared services transformation, and operational performance.
* Exercises decision-making authority over implementation, configuration alignment, workflow and business process design, user acceptance, vendor management, future-state operating model alignment, and continuous refinement across pre-award, post-award, agreements, effort reporting, personnel, and compliance modules.
* Manages vendor performance (including Huron), monitors project milestones, and reports status, risks, decisions, and outcomes to the Vice President and Steering Committee.
* Holds executive accountability for realization of transformation outcomes, including organizational effectiveness, service excellence, operational efficiency, adoption, and sustained performance improvement.
* Partners with AI & DS to implement technology programs and enabling capabilities required for responsible AI success. This includes project management, development and evaluation of workflows, tool evaluation, implementation, governance, workforce readiness, and adoption. Manages technology evaluation, implementation, and security coordination in partnership with Emory OIT and Information Security.
* Serves as ORA's operational technologies (Insight, SciShield, Huron, etc.) liaison to central technology and governance bodies.
* Provides subject matter expertise to the Learning and Organizational Development team for the design and deployment of a scalable, role-based training ecosystem that includes Insight and Compass system training, process-compliance content, change enablement, and professional development for ORA and school-based research administration staff.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, public administration, health administration, or a related field from an accredited institution and eight years of progressively responsible professional experience in related research administration experience, including a minimum of five years of experience in a management role with direct supervisory responsibility.
* Master's degree (MBA, MPA, MHA, MS, or related discipline) strongly preferred.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

* Master's degree or doctoral degree in a relevant field.
* Experience with Huron's Insight platform at an R1 university or academic medical center in a project leadership or system administration capacity.
* Direct, client-side experience supporting or co-leading a management consulting engagement (EY, Huron Consulting, Deloitte, or equivalent) in a research or academic operations context.
* Experience building or leading a training, learning and development, or organizational capability function in a higher education or healthcare research environment.
* Knowledge of AI governance frameworks, responsible AI principles, and federal data security and research security requirements.
* Demonstrated experience with process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or equivalent); certification preferred.
* Professional certification in one or more of the following: research administration (CRA or CPRA), project management (PMP), or change management (Prosci ADKAR / CCMP).
* Experience in a centralized or shared services research administration environment, particularly at an institution transitioning from a decentralized model.
* Familiarity with Emory University's systems, culture, and governance structure, or comparable experience at an AAU or Carnegie R1 institution.

NOTE: Position tasks are generally required to be performed in-person at an Emory University location. Remote work from home day options may be granted at department discretion. Emory reserves the right to change remote work status with notice to employee.

#LI-MR1

Additional Details: Emory is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by state or federal law. Emory University does not discriminate in admissions, educational programs, or employment, including recruitment, hiring, promotions, transfers, discipline, terminations, wage and salary administration, benefits, and training. Students, faculty, and staff are assured of participation in university programs and in the use of facilities without such discrimination. Emory University complies with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Era Veteran's Readjustment Assistance Act, and applicable executive orders, federal and state regulations regarding nondiscrimination, equal opportunity, and affirmative action (for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities). Inquiries regarding this policy should be directed to the Emory University Department of Equity and Civil Rights Compliance, 201 Dowman Drive, Administration Building, Atlanta, GA 30322. Telephone: 404-727-9867 (V) | 404-712-2049 (TDD).
 
 
Emory University is committed to ensuring equal access and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities upon request. To request this document in an alternate format or to seek a reasonable accommodation, please contact the Department of Accessibility Services at accessibility@emory.edu or call 404-727-9877 (Voice) | 404-712-2049 (TDD). We kindly ask that requests be made at least seven business days in advance to allow adequate time for coordination.

**This is a Stanford Health Care job.** 
 
**A Brief Overview** 
The Director of Supply Chain Operational Excellence is a senior leadership role driving enterprise‑wide efficiency, innovation, and transformation across a Gartner top‑2 ranked healthcare supply chain. With system‑wide influence and a seat at the leadership table, this role partners closely with the Chief Supply Chain Officer and Vice President of Strategic Initiatives to turn strategy into measurable results. The ideal candidate combines healthcare supply chain expertise with strong program management skills and a passion for developing people, leading change, and delivering measurable, enterprise‑wide impact. 
 
**Locations** 
Stanford Health Care 
 
**What you will do**

* Maintain continuous alignment with defined organizational and departmental strategic business objectives in conjunction with leadership.
* Direct and ensure the efficient operation of day-to-day activities of the team and ensure competency of all staff.
* Supports and partners on Change Management, Training and Communications activities as needed for effective performance improvement and project management.
* Act in an advisory capacity to all Supply Chain divisions, programs, staff and leaders.
* Provide expertise, guidance and training on Performance Improvement and Project Management best practices.
* Apply LEAN/Six Sigma principles and methods to identify waste reduction and performance optimization opportunities across Supply Chain operations.
* Implement, oversee and continuously improve Supply Chain systems, processes and standard work to drive the efficient management of operations across Logistics, Sourcing, Procurement, Business Office, Resiliency, Sustainability, Data Management and other functions.
* Build, develop and grow business relationships with Supply Chain’s key stakeholders and partners including but not limited to the Interventional Platform, A/P, Pharmacy, and IT.
* Lead cross-departmental initiatives, establishing strong governance, communication, and accountability to deliver progress measurable through mutually agreed KPIs.
* Align and collaborate with the enterprise Performance Improvement team and Stanford Operating System (SOS).
* Lead the implementation of programs and/or projects as assigned by the Administrative Director.

**Education Qualifications**

* Requires a Bachelor’s degree in a work-related discipline/field from an accredited college or university.
* Relevant experience in lieu of degree may be considered. Relevant experience in lieu of degree is in addition to the experience requirements for this position.

**Experience Qualifications**

* Seven (7) years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience.

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Must have strong leadership and interpersonal skills and be effective at people management including the ability to delegate assignments and share decision-making with team members and direct reports as appropriate.
* Excellent communication skills including the ability to present, and to write in a clear and understandable manner.
* Ability to understand complex verbal or written instructions and translate to action to deliver quantitative and qualitative results.
* Must be well organized and systematic, and able to design, implement and maintain standard work processes.
* Knowledge of project management methodologies to lead complex project teams and large scope projects, including managing resources (people, costs, time).
* Familiar with and able to apply Lean Six Sigma concepts and techniques including value stream mapping, kaizen, Five Whys, VoC, RCA etc. for structured process improvement.
* Demonstrated expertise in leading change management initiatives within Agile delivery environments.
* Ability to multi-task and handle multiple priorities while managing aggressive deadlines. Knowledge of Supply Chain functions, practices, and operational challenges.
* Understanding of healthcare and clinical concepts.

**Licenses and Certifications**

* Lean Six Sigma Certification preferred .
* PMP - Project Mgmt Professional preferred .
* CMRP (Certified Materials & Resource Professionals) preferred.

**Physical Demands and Work Conditions** 
**Blood Borne Pathogens**

* Category II - Tasks that involve NO exposure to blood, body fluids or tissues, but employment may require performing unplanned Category I tasks

**These principles apply to ALL employees:** 
 
**SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient & Family Experience** 
 
*Stanford Health Care sets a high standard for delivering value and an exceptional experience for our patients and families. Candidates for employment and existing employees must adopt and execute C-I-CARE standards for all of patients, families and towards each other. C-I-CARE is the foundation of Stanford’s patient-experience and represents a framework for patient-centered interactions. Simply put, we do what it takes to enable and empower patients and families to focus on health, healing and recovery.* 
 
*You will do this by executing against our three experience pillars, from the patient and family’s perspective:*

* Know Me: Anticipate my needs and status to deliver effective care
* Show Me the Way: Guide and prompt my actions to arrive at better outcomes and better health
* Coordinate for Me: Own the complexity of my care through coordination

new_roles.description:
**What makes DHL great?** Our People! We know each employee’s individual contributions make us the #1 Express Delivery and Logistics Company in the world.

***Distinguished as No. 1 World’s Best Workplace™ by Great Place to Work and Fortune Magazine***

DHL Express is committed to maintaining an environment that empowers every team member to make the greatest possible impact on our business. Our culture is about personal commitment – to our business, to each other and to our global communities. DHL is dedicated to being a great place to work. In addition to competitive compensation packages, our employees enjoy a range of programs, services and benefits that bring the best to their personal lives.

**Start YOUR career with DHL today…**

The **Sr. Director Operations** is responsible for providing strategic input and leading the implementation of the Courier and Pick-up & Delivery strategy. This role ensures the safe, secure, timely, and accurate transportation and delivery of mail, parcels, small packages, and legal documents between locations, in alignment with business objectives, operational requirements, corporate guidelines, and policies.

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Provide input to develop Couriers, Pick-up & Delivery operations strategy to deliver effective collection, transportation, and delivery of parcels while maintaining exceptional service quality and customer satisfaction.
* Plan, organize and control preparation of annual business plans, operational budgets, workforce planning, and resource allocation for delivery operations.
* Provide expertise, coaching, and leadership to frontline managers and supervisors to ensure execution of daily operational activities, achievement of performance targets, and development of future leaders.
* Manage and control service point operations to enable efficient collection, handling, and distribution of shipments while maintaining compliance with operational standards.
* Manage and control scheduling of transportation capacity, traffic volumes, route structures, and delivery resources to maximize productivity and service performance.
* Lead a workforce of more than 1,000 employees across multiple facilities, fostering a culture of accountability, engagement, safety, and operational excellence.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge and experience operating in unionized environments, including labor relations, contract interpretation, grievance resolution, workforce planning, and effective collaboration with union leadership.
* Oversee large independent contractor (IC) networks and transportation providers, ensuring contractual compliance, operational performance, cost management, and service reliability.
* Drive operational expense (OPEX) management through disciplined financial oversight, productivity initiatives, route optimization, and continuous improvement programs to achieve profitability objectives.
* Partner closely with Network Operations, Gateway Operations, Brokerage, Customs, Aviation, and Commercial teams to ensure seamless execution of customer commitments and network requirements.
* Deploy structured approaches to manage operational procedures including shipment processing, sorting, loading/unloading, documentation, scanning compliance, manifests, secure handling, and custody control.
* Implement reporting standards, performance metrics, and operational dashboards to provide visibility into service performance, cost drivers, productivity, and customer experience measures.
* Anticipate changes in customer demand, economic conditions, labor markets, and transportation trends to proactively adjust operational strategies and resource requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation, delivery, and customer service solutions through process redesign, technology implementation, and network optimization.
* Monitor operational performance and implement continuous improvement initiatives focused on service quality, productivity, safety, employee engagement, and cost control.
* Lead multiple delivery bases and service centers across geographically diverse markets, ensuring consistent execution of operational standards and business objectives.
* Champion safety, security, and compliance programs while maintaining adherence to company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Build strong relationships with key customers, local business leaders, and internal stakeholders to support growth initiatives and enhance the overall customer experience.
* Drive organizational change initiatives, workforce transformation efforts, and strategic projects across the region while maintaining high levels of employee engagement and operational performance.

**Skills/Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 8+ years of experience in operations and leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience in budgetary management and financial accountability.
* Strong background in business and operations management, including managing complex operational environments.
* Experience leading courier, Pick-up & Delivery, dock, and transportation operations.
* Proven ability to lead change management and operational improvement initiatives.
* Strong strategic planning and execution capabilities.
* Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Proven leadership experience managing a department or business unit comprising multiple teams, including Managers and/or Team Leaders.
* Strong ability to lead, develop, and influence leaders and teams to achieve business and operational objectives.
* Experience establishing priorities, managing resources, and driving performance across multiple operational functions.
* Demonstrated ability to drive employee engagement, foster an inclusive and high-performing culture, and develop strategies that strengthen employee experience, retention, and organizational effectiveness.

**Employee Benefits & Incentives**

DHL Express benefits and incentive offerings are designed to reflect a substantial experience for both employees and their dependents during their career and life journey. The specifics will vary, but wherever you join and in whatever role, you'll find our benefits and rewards are among the best in the industry They include:

* Competitive Pay - Salary Range New Jersey $187,950- $250,600
* Bonus/Incentive Programs
* Retirement Savings – 401K with company match
* Medical, Dental, Vision, well-being programs
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Generous Paid Time Off – Starting at 4 Weeks (PT/FT)
* Paid Leave
* Employee Discount Program
* Employee Assistance & Work Life Program
* Outstanding training opportunities

new_roles.title: Head of Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Overview:** 
 
Vanguard is building an enterprise Operational Excellence capability to strengthen end-to-end process ownership, improve efficiency, and embed continuous improvement across the organization. This newly created, highly visible role will serve as the architect and builder of that capability. The leader in this role will establish and scale Vanguard’s enterprise Operational Excellence management system, creating the strategy, operating model, process taxonomy, standards, methods, governance, tools, training, measures, and operating rhythms that enable business leaders to own and continuously improve their end-to-end processes.

The central capability will enable the businesses rather than execute improvement on their behalf. Success will require deep Operational Excellence expertise, enterprise-level operating model design, executive presence, and the ability to translate a technically rigorous discipline into a clear and compelling business imperative.

**What You Will Do:**

* Architect the enterprise Operational Excellence strategy and management system, including the operating model, governance, process taxonomy, decision rights, standards, methods, and management routines.
* Establish a federated model that clearly defines what the central team owns and what business-area leaders own, reinforcing accountability for process performance and sustained improvement.
* Create an enterprise framework for critical and high-risk processes, clarifying end-to-end ownership, expected outcomes, escalation paths, and review cadences.
* Build a common measurement system for process health, including definitions, benchmarks, performance indicators, executive dashboards, and business-area drill-downs that support transparent decision-making.
* Embed disciplined Lean Six Sigma and DMAIC practices, root-cause analysis, process redesign, simplification, and continuous improvement across a large, complex organization.
* Build and lead a new Operational Excellence organization, expected initially to include approximately 8 to 10 professionals, and define the capabilities, roles, talent strategy, and development model needed to scale.
* Partner with senior leaders across business, risk, technology, data, finance, and other enterprise functions to identify systemic issues and translate them into an integrated improvement portfolio.
* Influence prioritization and investment decisions using evidence, balancing client value, risk reduction, productivity, resilience, controls, strategic importance, and long-term enterprise value.
* Integrate existing transformation, risk, control, and process-improvement efforts into a coherent enterprise approach that builds on current foundations rather than creating a disconnected program.
* Build enterprise capability through standards, training, coaching, benchmarking, and practical tools, including the thoughtful use of automation, data, process mining, and AI-enabled approaches.
* Provide decision-ready insights and recommendations to senior officer audiences, Senior Staff, and the Board on process health, progress, emerging themes, dependencies, and investment needs.
* Create clarity, momentum, and followership by articulating what Operational Excellence means for Vanguard, why it matters, and what leaders and teams must do differently.

**What It Takes:**

* At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in Operational Excellence, enterprise transformation, business operations, process excellence, quality, or a related discipline, including leadership of complex, cross-functional initiatives.
* Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of training and experience. A graduate degree or relevant Operational Excellence certification is preferred.
* Deep expertise in Lean Six Sigma, DMAIC, continuous improvement, process redesign, root-cause analysis, process measurement, and quality or process-management systems.
* Master Black Belt certification or equivalent depth of practical expertise strongly preferred. The successful candidate must be capable of establishing the methodology, not simply sponsoring work performed by others.
* Demonstrated success designing, launching, or materially transforming an enterprise-scale Operational Excellence capability, center of excellence, management system, or federated process-management model.
* Proven ability to move beyond individual projects and create common standards, tools, governance, accountability, and adoption across multiple businesses or functions.
* Experience building a function, team, or capability from the ground up, including organization design, talent selection, capability building, and resource prioritization.
* Executive presence and communication skills, with a record of influencing highly senior leaders, translating technical concepts into business language, navigating resistance, and creating followership without relying solely on formal authority.
* A results orientation supported by quantifiable improvements in efficiency, cycle time, quality, defects, cost, operational risk, controls, client outcomes, automation, or sustained process performance.

new_roles.description:
Job Description
 
 
Director, U.S. Vaccines & Infectious Diseases Strategy & Operations
 
 
Position Description
 
 
The Director, U.S. Vaccines & Infectious Diseases Strategy & Operations is a key leadership role responsible for shaping and advancing the strategic and operational priorities of the U.S. Vaccines & Infectious Diseases Business Unit.
 
Reporting directly to the SVP, U.S. Vaccines & Infectious Diseases, this individual will serve as a strategic thought partner to the SVP and Leadership Team, translating business strategy into action, driving alignment across priorities, and enabling disciplined execution. The role requires a strong balance of strategic thinking, operational excellence, influence, and change leadership, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, connect across the organization, and accelerate progress against the BU's most important priorities.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities:** 

* Lead the BU strategic planning and operating process, including annual priority setting, Trimester planning and tracking, and ongoing assessment of progress against key objectives.
* Partner with the SVP and Leadership Team to translate strategy into action, identifying priorities, surfacing opportunities and risks, and driving alignment and accountability across the organization.
* Lead high-priority, cross-functional initiatives that advance BU strategy, transformation, and organizational capabilities, including evolving commercial capabilities, new ways of working, AI, and other emerging business priorities.
* Drive leadership effectiveness and decision-making by shaping and facilitating Leadership Team meetings, leader forums, strategic planning sessions, and other key business forums that enable alignment and action.
* Shape BU communications and engagement strategy, ensuring business priorities, strategic direction, and key messages are translated into clear and compelling communications across the organization, including Town Halls and other leadership forums.
* Partner with Leadership Team sponsors to advance talent, culture, and organizational priorities, including Talent & Culture working groups, employee development initiatives, and efforts to strengthen organizational capability and engagement.
* Partner across key financial planning processes, including forecasting, Profit Plan, and investor relations connecting strategic priorities with financial considerations and partnering across Finance and business stakeholders to enable informed decision-making.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen BU effectiveness, simplify ways of working, build organizational capabilities, and accelerate execution of strategic priorities.

**Required Experience:** 

* Bachelor's degree required.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in marketing, sales, market access, strategy and operations, marketing support, within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
* Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities, including the ability to assess complex business challenges, identify strategic choices, and develop clear recommendations.
* Proven ability to influence and lead without direct authority across complex, matrixed organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders, with the courage to challenge thinking, bring an independent point of view, and constructively navigate differing perspectives.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and evolving priorities, quickly create structure from white space, and move work forward with sound judgment and learning agility.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing demands, maintain focus on the highest-impact work, and align teams around clear priorities.
* Ability to inspire, motivate, mentor, and align others around a shared vision and clear priorities, with or without direct reporting relationships.
* Strong balance of strategic orientation and operational discipline, with the ability to move seamlessly between long-term priorities and near-term execution.
* Demonstrated ability to connect insights and priorities across functions and levels of the organization, bringing an enterprise perspective while maintaining focus on BU objectives.

**Preferred Experience and Skills:** 

* Vaccines and/or Infectious Diseases experience.
* Experience supporting or leading strategy and operations within a complex commercial organization.
* Experience leading enterprise or cross-functional transformation, capability-building, or change initiatives.

new_roles.title: Director, Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

Domino’s Pizza, which began in 1960 as a single store location in Ypsilanti, MI, has had a lot to celebrate lately: we’re a reshaped, reenergized brand of honesty, transparency and accountability – not to mention, great food! In the rise to becoming a true technology leader, the brand is now consistently one of the top five companies in online transactions and 65% of our sales in the U.S. are taken through digital channels. The brand continues to ‘deliver the dream’ to local business owners, 90% of which started as delivery drivers and pizza makers in our stores. That’s just the tip of the iceberg…or as we might say, one “slice” of the pie! If this sounds like a brand you’d like to be a part of, consider joining our team!

 **Job Description**

The Director, Continuous Improvement leads the Supply Chain-wide capability for identifying, prioritizing, enabling, and sustaining improvements that increase business performance and organizational effectiveness across functions and end-to-end processes. This role establishes a culture of continuous improvement, advances operational and business process excellence, and enables measurable improvements in productivity, cost, quality, service, and capacity.

Working closely with cross-functional Supply Chain leaders, this position standardizes processes, uses data and insights to prioritize opportunities, and implements sustainable solutions aligned with strategic objectives. The Director maintains a strong connection to frontline operations by working directly in Supply Chain Centers and other functional environments to understand processes firsthand and translate observations into meaningful improvements.

**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive Continuous Improvement strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned with Supply Chain priorities, and advise Supply Chain leadership on opportunities that improve productivity, efficiency, cost, service, quality, capacity, and organizational effectiveness.
* Lead the deployment of consistent Continuous Improvement methodologies, tools, governance, performance expectations, and resource prioritization across Supply Chain functions.
* Work directly with Supply Chain Centers and functional teams to observe work at the point of execution, identify process variation and non-value-added activities, and implement standardized processes, operating practices, management systems, standard work, and process controls.
* Lead cross-functional transformation and productivity initiatives, including process redesign, technology-enabled improvement, automation, and new ways of working, in partnership with functional leaders, the PMO, Finance, and other stakeholders.
* Establish measurable outcomes, baselines, KPI definitions, reporting standards, dashboards, and processes for tracking, validating, and sustaining financial benefits, productivity improvements, and business value.
* Build organizational Continuous Improvement capability through training, coaching, structured problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and the development of CI team members and functional leaders.
* Lead change management and cross-functional alignment, manage risks and barriers, strengthen process integration, and communicate priorities, progress, results, and recommendations to Supply Chain leadership and key stakeholders.

**What You’ll Bring**

In addition to the technical and functional requirements of this role, successful candidates demonstrate Domino's Hungry for MORE Ways of Working:

Be Curious

* Seeks clarity, asks thoughtful questions, and uncovers root causes to solve problems effectively.
* Actively pursues learning opportunities, applies feedback, and continuously develops new skills.

Connect the Dots

* Uses information and insights to identify opportunities and drive informed decisions.
* Builds strong partnerships across teams and considers the broader organizational impact of decisions.

Aim High

* Sets ambitious goals, challenges the status quo, and focuses on work that drives meaningful business results.
* Uses feedback and data to continuously improve performance and outcomes.

Shift Fast

* Adapts quickly to changing priorities and business needs while maintaining focus on results.
* Demonstrates resilience, sound judgment, and the ability to learn from setbacks.

Deliver More

* Takes ownership, executes with discipline, and consistently produces measurable results.
* Identifies opportunities to create additional value for customers, team members, and the business.

Leadership Expectations

* Builds and develops high-performing teams aligned to Domino’s Ways of Working.
* Creates accountability, fosters collaboration, and delivers results through others.
* Leads confidently through change while maintaining team engagement and performance.
* Demonstrates enterprise thinking and drives cross-functional alignment to achieve business goals.

 
**Qualifications** 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing, or a related discipline; an advanced degree or MBA is preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Supply Chain, business transformation, operational excellence, or related disciplines, including demonstrated leadership experience in complex, cross-functional organizations.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing Continuous Improvement strategies and delivering measurable business results across multiple functions or complex organizations.
* Strong knowledge and practical application of Lean Six Sigma, structured problem-solving, process optimization, standardization, and change management methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional improvement initiatives, influence stakeholders, and drive organizational change without direct authority.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience leading Continuous Improvement initiatives in manufacturing, distribution, logistics, or other complex operational environments, including the ability to engage frontline employees, site leaders, and senior executives to diagnose issues, implement solutions, and deliver measurable results.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including experience identifying, quantifying, and validating productivity improvements, cost savings, and business value.
* Well-developed team building and influencing skills, unquestioned integrity, and the experience and confidence to work effectively across multiple functions and levels of the organization.
* Experience developing performance management frameworks, leveraging data analytics, and translating insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to build organizational capability through coaching, talent development, and deployment of Continuous Improvement methodologies.
* Strong strategic thinking, communication, collaboration, and executive presentation skills.
* Experience managing complex improvement portfolios, prioritizing competing business needs, and delivering sustainable outcomes.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent demonstrated Continuous Improvement expertise is preferred.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally, including Canada, as business needs require. Expected travel is up to 50%

 
**Additional Information**

Benefits: 

* Paid Holidays and Vacation
* Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment
* No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents
* Childcare tuition discounts
* No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs
* Fertility benefits
* Adoption assistance
* 401k matching contributions
* 15% off the purchase price of stock
* Company bonus

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

new_roles.title: 7 Brew Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
Description:

**Why 7 Brew? Because We Invest in YOU!**

At 7 Brew, it’s more than coffee—it’s about brewing smiles one cup at a time. We’re built on kindness, connection, and community, and every guest interaction is an opportunity to make someone’s day brighter.

Brewtopia, a passionate franchise group, is proud to bring the bold energy of 7 Brew to Southeast Michigan. With proven success in quick-service restaurants, we’re dedicated to operational excellence, people-first leadership, and a high-energy drive-thru experience that stands out.

We’re looking for a high-energy, people-first Director of Operations to lead our drive-thru coffee operations. This is a unique opportunity to shape the culture, systems, and guest experience from the ground up—and to grow with us as we expand.

**OUR VALUES**

* Strive for Excellence – We raise the bar every day.
* Elevate Others – We build people up.
* Results Driven – We focus on impact.
* Visionary – We dream big and lead with purpose.
* Exceed Expectations – We go beyond what’s expected.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* **Competitive Salary:** $125,000 base per year
* **Performance Bonus:** 15% target, tied to KPIs and company performance
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Health insurance, 401K with competitive match, generous PTO
* **Car Allowance:** Up to $500 /month
* **Cellphone Stipend:** Up to $25 a pay
* **Growth & Learning:** Clear development plans and a culture of continuous improvement
* **More Than Coffee:** Infused energy drinks, Italian sodas, smoothies, teas, and more!

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

The Director of Operations ensures consistency, quality, and efficiency across all locations—protecting the brand and growing guest loyalty. This role optimizes profitability, develops strong leaders, and executes strategic growth initiatives with relentless focus on the guest.

* **Operations & Guest Experience:** Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple drive-thru shops, ensuring speed of service, drink quality, food safety, cleanliness, and brand consistency.
* **Team Leadership & Development:** Lead, mentor, and develop Regional Leaders and General Managers, fostering a culture of accountability, recognition, and continuous growth.
* **Financial Management & Strategic Growth:** Own the P&L, manage labor and COGS, drive sales and flow-through, and collaborate with leadership to execute growth strategies and support new shop openings.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Drive Growth & Profitability:** Regularly review and adjust the budget and financial reports to ensure cost goals are met. Implement strategies to optimize labor, track performance against financial goals, and ensure key profit-driving actions are executed in a timely manner.
* **Ensure Operational Excellence:** Conduct daily operational reviews to ensure adherence to brand standards. Regularly assess performance metrics, respond to customer feedback, and implement action plans to improve service quality.
* **Lead & Develop Teams:** Hold weekly one-on-one coaching sessions with Regional Managers, ensuring consistent training and development. Work with HR and other departments to fill staffing gaps quickly and develop training programs that align with business needs.
* **Foster Guest Satisfaction & Compliance:** Address and resolve guest concerns within 24 hours, ensuring that guest satisfaction is prioritized.
* **Collaborate & Align:** Actively participate in weekly leadership meetings, contribute to discussions, and align team goals with corporate objectives. Share progress updates and ensure all team members are informed and working toward shared priorities.
* **Culture Keeper:** Foster a recognition culture, coach privately and praise publicly, and promote healthy competition and collaboration across locations.

Requirements:

**ESSENTIAL SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Leadership & Team Management:** Proven ability to build, coach, and scale high-performing multi-unit teams
* **Financial Acumen:** Budgeting, P&L ownership, labor modeling, KPI-driven decisions
* **Operational Excellence:** Multi-unit drive-thru/QSR expertise with a bias for speed, quality, and safety
* **Problem-Solving and Decision-Making:** Data-driven, resourceful, and decisive in a fast-paced environment
* **Communication:** Clear, candid communicator across shop, field, and corporate partners
* **Customer Focus:** Passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences consistently
* **Strategic Planning & Execution:** Translate goals into disciplined, scalable routines
* **Compliance & Safety:** Knowledge of health, safety, and regulatory standards
* **Technology Proficiency:** POS/back-office, labor scheduling, spreadsheets/dashboards

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE**

* Multi-unit leadership in QSR/coffee/drive-thru; ideally **2+ years in a director-level role**
* Bachelor's in business management, Hospitality, or related field is a plus

**PHYSICAL AND TIME REQUIREMENTS**

* **General Mobility:** Sit, stand, bend, and move for extended periods during meetings, presentations, or line work
* **Manual Dexterity:** Proficiency in typing and using office equipment such as computers, printers, and phones
* **Visual and Auditory Acuity:** Ability to read printed and digital documents; clear hearing for communication
* **Lifting and Carrying:** Ability to lift and carry items weighing up to 50 pounds
* **Travel:** Frequent travel to multiple locations (>75%)

**TIME REQUIREMENT**

* Availability to primarily work during areas of business growth, including nights and weekends.

**Ready to bring the brew and bring your best?**

Join the Brewtopia movement today! If you’re ready for an epic, energetic, and rewarding journey, we’d love to have you on the crew. But first – let’s get to know you better! Start your journey with us by completing a quick **5-7 minute Culture Index survey**. It's a key part of the process, and we promise – it’s quick, easy, and essential!

Survey Link: https://surveys.cultureindex.com/s/y8HlLcvMA4/93831

**Disclaimer**

This job description outlines the general responsibilities and expectations of the role. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, or requirements.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered fairly and without discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, or any other protected status. Hiring decisions are made solely on job-related qualifications and business needs.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**About Us** 
Ten Five Hospitality is a growing collective of restaurants, bars, and entertainment venues known for concept-driven experiences and standout hospitality. Headquartered between Los Angeles and Miami, Ten Five holds a history of working with and crafting some of the most sought after brands in the world. Ten Five represents the organizational, operational and creative excellence to bring original and authentic visions to life while outperforming the market on the bottom-line.

**Position Summary**

The Director of Operations – Restaurants is responsible for overseeing effective operating procedures within the restaurant while developing a successful management team.

**Daily Responsibilities**

* Plan and direct administration and planning functions of the Food & Beverage department to meet the daily needs of the operation.
* Clearly describe, assign, and delegate responsibility and authority for the operation of the various food & beverage positions.
* Possesses knowledge of all front-of-house job duties.
* Provides financial oversight and prepares and presents financial and operations reports.
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of all operational systems in use including but not limited to payroll, inventory and purchasing.
* Ensures that all mechanical systems are in good working order and compliant with all federal, state and local ordinances.
* Regulates all executive-level POS functions.
* Oversee and supervise the execution of front-of-house operations to ensure quality, safety, efficiency, and profitability.
* Assists managers in establishing and achieving predetermined profit objectives and desired standards of quality of food, service, cleanliness and promotion.
* Responsible, with the Executive Chef and General Manager, for maintaining the venue’s monthly Profit & Loss statement standards while meeting or exceeding budget expectations through controlling P&L items.
* Oversees that training programs are in place for employees to update their knowledge on relevant industry practices.
* Oversees that the venue is compliant with all federal, state, and local laws and regulations and company policies.
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of all food and beverage menus.
* Oversees that all guest and employee concerns are resolved in a way that promotes guest retention.
* Oversees the replacement or repair of all breakage or damage of equipment, furniture, or other company property.
* Ensures front-of-house employees follow all policies and procedures by providing clear guidelines and expectations.
* Maintain professional appearance standards as directed in the Employee Handbook.
* Anticipates and accommodates needs of guests while providing professional and exceptional service to ensure guest satisfaction.
* Protects establishment, guests, and employees by adhering to and overseeing that the Department of Health and company sanitation standards are followed.
* Responsible for management interviewing, hiring, and training process decisions.
* Coaches front-of-house managers as needed and assists in their professional development.

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to stand, walk, lift, and bend for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to bend and lift up to 50 lbs.
* Role may include job duties or tasks requiring repetitive motions.
* Exposure to hot kitchen elements or cleaning materials.

**Skills/Experience**

* Minimum five (5) years’ experience working in a general management role in hospitality/nightlife/ bars.
* Passionate about hospitality, food and beverage and morale/culture.
* Ability to think proactively and creatively, have decision making and analytical skills and be effective in written and verbal communication.
* Self-motivated with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, effectively multi-task, and drive results.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays when required.

*We are an equal opportunity employer.*

new_roles.title: Director Engineering Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Job ID: 116026**

 

The Leonardo DRS Naval Electronics business provides leading naval computing infrastructure, network and data distribution and middleware enterprise services, as well as world-class manufacturing and support capabilities.

**Business Unit**: Naval Electronics
 
**Location**: Eagan, MN
 
**Career Functional Area**: Engineering
 
**Telework Type**: Hybrid
 
**Travel Expectation**: 30%
 
**Schedule**: 9/80

**Job Summary**
---------------

Responsible for establishing and continuously improving the processes, tools, and data-management practices that enable disciplined, compliant, and efficient engineering execution across all programs. Own engineering configuration-management standards, processes and execution releasing the E BOM. Monitor the quality of engineering deliverables identifying opportunities of improvement.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Engineering Process Ownership and Excellence**

* Define, deploy, maintain, and continuously improve standardized engineering processes, procedures, work instructions, templates
* Ensure engineering processes are practical for program execution while meeting applicable customer, contractual, quality, regulatory, cybersecurity, and internal requirements.
* Establish process ownership, approval authorities, compliance expectations, training requirements, and periodic process-review cycles.
* Lead process maturity assessments, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and implement corrective and preventive improvements.

**Engineering Tools and Digital Strategy**

* Define the engineering tools strategy, roadmap, governance model, and deployment plans in partnership with Engineering, IT, Quality, Supply Chain, and program teams.
* Lead deployment, adoption, administration requirements, user support models, and continuous improvement of engineering tools, including product lifecycle management, requirements management, analysis, collaboration, and configuration-management tools.
* Ensure tools, workflows, data structures, and integrations support disciplined engineering execution, traceability, release control, and reliable engineering data.
* Capture user and program needs; prioritize enhancements, integrations, and new capabilities based on business value, risk reduction, compliance, and program demand.

**Engineering Configuration Management**

* Own the engineering configuration-management process, standards, governance, and associated tool workflows.
* Establish common rules for engineering baselines, configuration identification, revision control, change management, release authorization, and configuration-status accounting.
* Ensure configuration-management processes support full traceability between requirements, drawings, parts, assemblies, bills of material, changes, verification evidence, and released product definition.
* Define the governance framework for configuration control boards and ensure appropriate technical, quality, programmatic, manufacturing, supply-chain, and customer inputs are incorporated where required.

**Job Responsibilities (Cont.)**
--------------------------------

**Program Configuration-Management Support**

* Provide configuration-management process leadership and tailored support to programs from proposal through product support.
* Support development, review, and maintenance of program Configuration Management Plans and related configuration-management deliverables.
* Establish program-specific configuration baselines, release schedules, change-control workflows, approval matrices, and reporting appropriate to contractual and product requirements.
* Support programs in resolving configuration-management issues, ensuring timely decisions and minimizing release, production, and customer-impact risk.

**Product-Definition Data Integrity**

* Govern the processes for drawing-number creation, part-number assignment, nomenclature, document classification, and engineering-data release.
* Ensure new drawing and part numbers are created, controlled, and uniquely identified in accordance with approved standards and system rules.
* Establish validation controls for engineering drawings, parts, assemblies, and engineering bills of material (EBOMs), including consistency, completeness, revision alignment, and traceability.
* Monitor the integrity of released product-definition data and drive resolution of discrepancies that could affect procurement, manufacturing, verification, sustainment, or customer deliverables.

**Engineering Deliverable Quality and Performance Monitoring**

* Define the quality criteria, review expectations, and performance measures for engineering deliverables.
* Monitor the quality, completeness, timeliness, and first-pass acceptance of engineering outputs, including requirements artifacts, drawings, specifications, analysis reports, test documentation, change packages, and released product data.
* Analyze defects, rework, late changes, release escapes, configuration discrepancies, and recurring nonconformities to identify systemic causes and improvement opportunities.
* Provide leadership with regular visibility into engineering-process performance, deliverable quality trends, compliance risks, and recommended corrective actions.

**Continuous Improvement and Assurance**

* Lead improvement initiatives that strengthen engineering execution, reduce rework, improve data quality, and increase delivery predictability.
* Develop and recommend improvement actions based on performance data, audit findings, lessons learned, user feedback, program needs, and changes in business or customer requirements.
* Verify the effectiveness of implemented improvements and maintain an actionable backlog of process, tool, and data-governance enhancements.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining objective evidence of process compliance, configuration control, tool governance, and engineering-data integrity.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; advanced degree or relevant professional certification preferred
* 10+ years of progressive experience in engineering, engineering operations, configuration management, PLM, quality, or systems engineering within a complex and regulated product environment.
* 5+ years in a leadership role responsible for engineering processes, tools, configuration management, quality, or operational excellence.
* Experience developing and deploying engineering processes, governance controls, workflows, and performance measures.
* Experience leading implementation and improvement of engineering tools, including PLM, requirements-management, design-data management, and configuration-management systems.
* Practical experience with Configuration Management Plans, engineering change control, drawing and part-number management, release control, and EBOM validation.
* Proven record of improving engineering deliverable quality, data integrity, process compliance, and operational efficiency

**Additional Qualifications**
-----------------------------

* Strong knowledge of engineering product-development processes, configuration management, product-data control, and engineering release practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders in a matrix organization.
* Strong analytical, communication, and continuous-improvement skills

**U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.**

*The salary range for this position is $161,180/year- $250,000/year. This range reflects the good faith estimate of pay the employer is willing to offer at the time of posting. Several factors can influence the pay scale, including but not limited to: Federal contract labor categories and contract wage rates, collective bargaining agreements, geographic location, business considerations, scope, and responsibilities of the position, local or other applicable market conditions, and internal equity. Other factors include the candidate’s qualifications such as prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education/training, and certifications. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for: annual performance-based bonuses, equity awards, and overtime pay (for non-exempt employees as applicable. Our benefits package includes comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision), employer matching 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off including vacation, holidays, and sick leave (including ant state-mandated paid sick leave), parental leave benefits, tuition reimbursement, professional development support, and life and disability insurance coverage.*

 

*Taking care of our people is a top priority at Leonardo DRS. We are proud to offer competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a company contribution to a health savings account, telemedicine, life and disability insurance, legal insurance, and a 401(k) savings plan. We champion wellness programs that focus on physical, emotional, and financial well-being. We develop our talent by offering programs and activities to support career-growth, professional development, and skill enhancement. And we understand there is more to life than work, and the importance of offering flexible work schedules with our 9/80 program, competitive vacation, health/emergency leave, paid parental leave, and community service hours.* 

* *Some employees are eligible for limited benefits only*

 

*Leonardo DRS, Inc. and its subsidiaries provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.*
